name: LanceDB v0.40.0
body:
This stable release uses **Lance 13.0.0** and is maintained on [`release/v0.40`](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/tree/release/v0.40).

**Java packaging:** Use `com.lancedb:lancedb-core:0.40.0`. The Maven artifacts were built from [release-branch commit 711deef7](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/commit/711deef76620580d4b46c959734732f6ae711627), which corrects version serialization in the tag's Maven POMs. The Java runtime code is unchanged.

## 🛠 Breaking Changes

- feat: add persistent OAuth token cache and session APIs by @jackye1995 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4182
- feat(remote): support materialized view APIs by @jackye1995 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4180
- feat: use oauth2 crate for OAuth with configurable client auth by @jackye1995 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4181
- feat(rust): add zonemap index builder by @ChilePiquin in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4199
- feat(secrets): named Secrets, bindings, and namespace addressing by @jmhsieh in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4150
- feat: define a materialized view by its query, with Functions in FROM position by @wkalt in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4190
- feat: group a materialized view by GROUP BY by @wkalt in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4222
- fix(node): reject unsupported object row values by @lancedb-gatefixer[bot] in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4307
- feat(sql): add native vector dedup and partitioned mv refresh by @BubbleCal in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4303
- feat(functions): address Functions by namespace path by @jmhsieh in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4341

## 🎉 New Features

- feat: add persistent OAuth token cache and session APIs by @jackye1995 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4182
- feat(remote): support materialized view APIs by @jackye1995 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4180
- feat(oidc): support resource and audience by @cmccabe in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4193
- feat(nodejs): add JSON field helper by @mikemikimike in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4082
- feat: represent registered Functions by OCI image identity by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4176
- feat: use oauth2 crate for OAuth with configurable client auth by @jackye1995 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4181
- feat: add remote catalogs and Python and TypeScript bindings by @jackye1995 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4195
- feat(rust): add zonemap index builder by @ChilePiquin in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4199
- feat: index builders for NGram, BloomFilter, RTree by @cmccabe in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4205
- feat(secrets): named Secrets, bindings, and namespace addressing by @jmhsieh in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4150
- feat(python): add TypeSafe reranker by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4209
- feat: list a table's per-row Function errors from the client by @wkalt in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4208
- feat(rust): make MetadataEraserExec public by @vivek-bharathan in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4213
- feat: define a materialized view by its query, with Functions in FROM position by @wkalt in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4190
- feat: retire a Function binding when its output columns are dropped by @wkalt in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4231
- feat(remote): support add_columns with schema in remote client by @rpgreen in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4244
- feat: group a materialized view by GROUP BY by @wkalt in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4222
- feat: return a cleanup job from drop_function by @jackye1995 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4237
- feat: group a materialized view by the IVF partition of a vector column by @wkalt in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4223
- feat: add view CRUD APIs by @jackye1995 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4236
- feat: carry Function initialization in the canonical model by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4253
- feat: refresh an ivf-grouped materialized view in units by @wkalt in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4232
- feat(python): class Functions with initialization and shipped helper code by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4254
- feat: return a cleanup job from drop_view by @jackye1995 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4262
- feat(python): add opt-in request batching to TypeSafeReranker by @tsmithv11 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4316
- feat: pause and resume jobs from the Python SDK by @wkalt in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4112
- feat(query): dedup hybrid search by primary key on MemWAL tables by @hamersaw in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4268
- feat(python): pass batch_size and other CrossEncoder kwargs by @AyushExel in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4328
- feat(sql): add native vector dedup and partitioned mv refresh by @BubbleCal in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4303
- feat(node): expose allowExternalBlobOutsideBases in Table.add by @ningsh7 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4317
- feat(sql): expose composable native vector relations by @BubbleCal in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4340
- feat(node): expose seek, tell, bounded read, readRanges and close on BlobFile by @BilalAtique in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4348
- feat(node): accept an AbortSignal to cancel blob reads by @BilalAtique in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4350
- feat(functions): address Functions by namespace path by @jmhsieh in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4341

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- fix: redact authentication headers from debug logs by @jackye1995 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4179
- fix: keep computed-column freshness across branches and clones by @wkalt in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4188
- fix: shut down the shared Tokio runtime on interpreter exit by @ChilePiquin in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4175
- fix: accept all-null batches and plain JSON strings for json columns by @wjones127 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4067
- fix: do not allow . and .. as table names by @cmccabe in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4191
- fix(python): correct pylance test extra pin by @Risto0211 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4051
- fix: expose public FTS paths in remote index listings by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4194
- fix(node): prevent OAuth tests from launching browsers by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4196
- fix: return InvalidTableName instead of panicking in open_table/create_table by @joaquinhuigomez in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4192
- fix: widen zonemap index type support by @ChilePiquin in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4206
- fix: scope the Function binding guard on schema evolution to the bound columns by @wkalt in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4204
- fix: accept synchronous remote materialized-view drops by @jackye1995 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4212
- fix(python): decode file URIs in OpenCLIP by @yhz5613813 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4131
- fix(python): reduce Windows release wheel size by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4241
- fix: keep REST server adapter out of production dependencies by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4240
- fix(python): convert objects for JSON fields by @Rudra-G-23 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4211
- fix(node): reject unsupported object row values by @lancedb-gatefixer[bot] in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4307
- fix(python): prevent BlobFile finalizer panics on Tokio workers by @lancedb-gatefixer[bot] in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4291
- fix: isolate remote table checkout state per handle by @lancedb-gatefixer[bot] in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4310
- fix(python): warn instead of failing on local imports in @udf source by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4318
- fix(node): write NaN and Infinity as SQL literals in table.update by @breken-ai in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4327
- fix(python): warn when optimize cleans up all old versions by @jayzhou2309 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4337
- fix(python): apply the default limit of 10 to sync hybrid queries by @MohammadHijjawi97 in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4344
- fix(python): write NaN and infinity as SQL literals in table.update by @breken-ai in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4326
- fix(python): rank each result list separately in RRF multivector rerank by @breken-ai in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4325
- fix: handle remote blob fetch request caps by @lancedb-gatefixer[bot] in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4309
- fix: pin remote BlobFile reads to the opened version by @lancedb-gatefixer[bot] in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4295
- fix(python): preserve mixed blob values before Arrow conversion by @lancedb-gatefixer[bot] in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4304
- fix(rust): list indices when an FTS index's files are missing by @BilalAtique in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4330
- fix(python): support typed embedding vector fields by @lancedb-gatefixer[bot] in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/3826
- fix(node): support LargeUtf8 and LargeBinary Arrow columns by @lancedb-gatefixer[bot] in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4287

## 🔧 Build and CI

- ci(python): build Windows release wheel on 8-core runner by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4264
